description: Audited statement correspondence; exact source references, not generated live website links. Includes auxiliary formal definitions and empirical/external boundaries.

rows.label: def:quantised-inference
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Nonnegative literal weights, bounded threshold in minimum-weight units; not arbitrary quantised networks.

rows.label: rem:ac0-scope
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: A growing threshold is excluded by the declared gate model.

rows.label: rem:local-vs-global-parity
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Global obstruction uses the named classical parity-correlation premise.

rows.label: thm:sim-ac0
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Fixed depth, latency, quantisation bounds; staged attention requires gate-realised operations.

rows.label: app:ac0proof
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Fixed depth, latency, quantisation bounds; staged attention requires gate-realised operations.

rows.label: def:impartial
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: General Sprague-Grundy theory is cited background; NIM is the formalised game.

rows.label: def:nim
rows.claim: NIM moves, XOR and winning positions
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Finite normal-play NIM, nonnegative heap sizes.

rows.label: def:nimsum
rows.claim: NIM moves, XOR and winning positions
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Finite normal-play NIM, nonnegative heap sizes.

rows.label: thm:nim-win
rows.claim: NIM moves, XOR and winning positions
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Finite normal-play NIM, nonnegative heap sizes.

rows.label: def:mastery
rows.claim: History-dependent weak and strong mastery, pairing, separation
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Designated role, initial family, deterministic policies, legal opponents, illegal/missing actions forfeit; losing starts give vacuous weak mastery.

rows.label: app:weak
rows.claim: History-dependent weak and strong mastery, pairing, separation
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Designated role, initial family, deterministic policies, legal opponents, illegal/missing actions forfeit; losing starts give vacuous weak mastery.

rows.label: thm:singleframe-impossible
rows.claim: Winning-move parity reduction and family obstruction
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Parity hardness is an explicit classical input; all reduction boards are winning.

rows.label: def:nimber-difference
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Fixed aligned heap indices.

rows.label: lem:nimber-diff-ac0
rows.claim: At most a constant number of changed heaps
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Promise at most t changes; polynomial exponent depends on fixed t.

rows.label: app:nimberdiff
rows.claim: At most a constant number of changed heaps
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Promise at most t changes; polynomial exponent depends on fixed t.

rows.label: prop:restore
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Previous board has nim-sum zero and opponent transition is legal.

rows.label: def:rollout-policy
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: One fixed structured head; query corrections included in bounded-depth readout; no unrestricted transformed starts.

rows.label: def:agent-types
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: One fixed structured head; query corrections included in bounded-depth readout; no unrestricted transformed starts.

rows.label: rem:why-multi-head
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: One fixed structured head; query corrections included in bounded-depth readout; no unrestricted transformed starts.

rows.label: par:shootout-controller
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Read-only original board each tick; all-head move selection distinct from early classification. M+2B+2 includes reset and readout.

rows.label: par:controller-costs
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Read-only original board each tick; all-head move selection distinct from early classification. M+2B+2 includes reset and readout.

rows.label: prop:rollout-sufficiency
rows.claim: Executed rollouts recover invariant and select winning move
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: B channels; simulated legal moves bounded by BN(2^B-1); total horizon grows.

rows.label: app:rollout-proofs
rows.claim: Executed rollouts recover invariant and select winning move
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: B channels; simulated legal moves bounded by BN(2^B-1); total horizon grows.

rows.label: prop:single-policy-bound
rows.claim: One channel gives one affine invariant bit
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Structured fixed head and known one-heap modifications.

rows.label: rem:noisy-rollout-decay
rows.claim: Real probability law and minimum sample complexity
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: 0<=epsilon<1/2; fresh independent blocks; 0<a<=1/2 for bounds; worst-case error 1/4; arbitrary randomized decision rules. Not a model of erroneous legal moves.

rows.label: app:noise-samples
rows.claim: Real probability law and minimum sample complexity
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: 0<=epsilon<1/2; fresh independent blocks; 0<a<=1/2 for bounds; worst-case error 1/4; arbitrary randomized decision rules. Not a model of erroneous legal moves.

rows.label: prop:noise-samples
rows.claim: Real probability law and minimum sample complexity
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: 0<=epsilon<1/2; fresh independent blocks; 0<a<=1/2 for bounds; worst-case error 1/4; arbitrary randomized decision rules. Not a model of erroneous legal moves.

rows.label: thm:search-gap
rows.claim: Finite success bound, asymptotic application and attainability
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Fixed B>=2 and uniform winning boards; named HastadNegl input implies needed indicator correlation. External analytic negligible-rate deduction.

rows.label: app:search-gap-proof
rows.claim: Finite success bound, asymptotic application and attainability
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Fixed B>=2 and uniform winning boards; named HastadNegl input implies needed indicator correlation. External analytic negligible-rate deduction.

rows.label: eq:finite-correlation-bound
rows.claim: Finite success bound, asymptotic application and attainability
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Fixed B>=2 and uniform winning boards; named HastadNegl input implies needed indicator correlation. External analytic negligible-rate deduction.

rows.label: prop:streaming-nimsum
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Aligned B-bit rows, completed frames, validity flag and reset; stores summaries rather than entire history.

rows.label: prop:bypass-interfaces
rows.claim: All three constructions, resource families, whole-game composition
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Two-frame promise; recurrent replay supplied by environment; complete rollout/recurrent maps excluded from AC0 conditional on parity hardness. ReplayWins uses its existing game semantics, not new Hist predicate.

rows.label: def:fourier-tail
rows.claim: Fourier basis, expansion, tail and parity-correlation inequality
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Uniform Boolean cube; epsilon>=0; character degree exceeds cutoff.

rows.label: eq:tail-correlation
rows.claim: Fourier basis, expansion, tail and parity-correlation inequality
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Uniform Boolean cube; epsilon>=0; character degree exceeds cutoff.

rows.label: eq:delta-extension
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Equals delta on at-most-one-change domain; not a signed character for N>=2, bit j<B; N=1 degree two.

rows.label: sec:spectral-view
rows.claim: Nim-bit spectrum and classical tail discussion
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: LMN/Tal TailPremise not instantiated against exact published size/depth conventions. This discussion is not needed for main search bound.

rows.label: app:RNN
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Fixed total unrolling; full row scan deliberately leaves this restriction.

rows.label: def:RNN-formal
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Fixed total unrolling; full row scan deliberately leaves this restriction.

rows.label: app:LTST
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: No reduction of standard softmax attention is claimed.

rows.label: def:LTST-formal
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: No reduction of standard softmax attention is claimed.

rows.label: app:oneunit
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Classical depth counts AND/OR layers; NOT-counting bound may add one.

rows.label: lem:unit-ac0
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Classical depth counts AND/OR layers; NOT-counting bound may add one.

rows.label: app:network
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Fixed gate bound and polynomial widths.

rows.label: lem:layer-ac0
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Fixed gate bound and polynomial widths.

rows.label: app:impl
rows.claim: Binary outputs and threshold compiler resources
rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Counts total output formula nodes; weights/thresholds 0/1; board-storage and replay have different space/time.

rows.hypotheses_and_boundary: Numerical baseline theorem does not certify checkpoints or the causal mechanism of the 0.54 plateau. Saved-data diagnostics remain empirical.
